title: Blocked corridor; detour inside lease zone
why_local_cloud: T4 uses a LOCAL cloud, not the deployed endpoint, for two test-scoped reasons: (1) the 'blocked corridor with a detour INSIDE the lease zone' case needs a controlled map/scenario configuration (a compressed-timing pack and a deterministically placed obstacle) that is NOT part of the actual deployed hospital map -- the detour scenario requires custom map/scenario changes, so we run it locally rather than reshape the real hospital map; and (2) the bad link is injected with an in-process FaultProxy, which cannot be applied against a managed HTTPS endpoint from this host. T1/T8 need neither and use the deployed C1/C2 endpoints.
note: Edge = the real supervisor (C1 SLM / C2 relay / C3 rules), kinematic mock robot, driven in-process. A persistent corridor obstacle forces a tactical decision; a detour exists inside the lease. The edge<->cloud link is degraded for the whole mission by an in-process FaultProxy (latency+jitter+loss), not tc. C1 and C3 decide the detour LOCALLY (link not on the decision path) and are fast; C2 must round-trip to the cloud per decision and stalls on the bad link. Completion time and decision latency are measured, not inferred.
